name: Bromos Grummner
summary: In Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner trains young dwarven paladins in the Holy Light. He teaches steadfast faith and the bond between dwarves and humans in the Knights of the Silver Hand.

sections.title: A Beacon in Coldridge
sections.body: In Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner welcomes dwarven novices to the discipline of the Holy Light. He teaches young paladins their martial rites and sacred invocations. Beyond combat, Bromos urges unity. The Knights of the Silver Hand bring Ironforge and the human kingdoms of the Alliance together in a shared righteous purpose.

faq.answer: Bromos Grummner trains new dwarven paladins in Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley within Dun Morogh. He gives them basic training, spells, and spiritual guidance.
Bromos represents the Knights of the Silver Hand. He teaches the importance of the bond between humans and dwarves, forged under the holy order's banner.

faq.q: What does he teach new recruits?
faq.answer: He teaches new paladins basic combat arts and divine spells. He gives initiates early trials to prove their dedication to the Light and readiness to protect Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarven paladin, you can look to Bromos as your first spiritual mentor. He introduces you to the sacred duties of the Silver Hand.
As a dwarf, you follow a long tradition of devotion to the Light and fight beside your human allies.
